forms.species: medium-sized dog with upright ears and a curled tail
forms.desc: sitting on its haunches with straight front legs side by side, hind legs folded with the hocks flat on the ground, chest up, head raised and facing forward, ears upright, tail curled over the back
forms.keep: sit, straight front legs side by side, folded hind legs with hocks on the ground, ears upright, tail curled over the back

forms.species: medium-sized dog with upright ears and a curled tail
forms.desc: running at full gallop in the extended phase: both front legs stretched far forward, both hind legs stretched far back, all four paws off the ground, body long and level, head forward, ears back

forms.species: large dog with drop ears and a long straight tail
forms.desc: lying down in a sphinx position: belly on the ground, front legs stretched straight forward parallel, hind legs folded under the hips, head raised and facing forward, drop ears hanging, tail lying straight behind
forms.keep: sphinx down, belly on the ground, front legs straight forward and parallel, hind legs folded under the hips, head up, drop ears, tail straight behind
